plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Electronic Systems Engineering Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every fixed course, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. The inventoried program 'Electronic Systems Engineering Technology' is listed in the mapper under that name; the program page states the student will be awarded an Associate of Science degree and prints no separate total-units statement. This plan transcribes the first-listed 2026-2027 pathway, 'Bakersfield College / Electronic Systems Engineering Technology / Associate of Science / 65-66.5 units / 4 terms / to CSU', in full; the page shows only the 4-term Bakersfield College segment. The second 2026-2027 pathway ('to Degree', 60-61.5 units, 4 terms) uses the Bakersfield College general-education pattern and is not collected as a separate plan. In 2025-2026 detailed maps existed in 6 terms for both pathways. The transcribed map prints term totals as 15-16.5 / 17 / 17 / 16. The only ranged row is Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention that row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 65 units. MATH C2211 and PHYS B2A are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The Term 4 'Major List A' slot prints a closed two-course option set (ENGR B25 Engineering Graphics with AutoCAD (for CE/CET/EE); INDR B12 Introduction to Drafting and CAD); per the standing slot convention the options are named here and the slot itself is recorded unselected. MATH C2211, ELET B1B, MATH C2221, PHYS B2A, ENGR B19C and PHYS B2B carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no other row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. No separate Certificate program named Electronic Systems Engineering Technology exists in the mapper. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
